pairs.subject: eval-harness
pairs.evidence: src/hooks/design/core/useDesignAnalysis.ts:169 The hooks call the design model and send its streamed result to UI state, but nothing here runs that model against declared scenarios or scores what it returns. A recursive search of src/hooks/design found no judge, rubric, benchmark or pass-rate terms. The only 'eval' hits are predicate evaluation in negotiatorStepGraph.ts and the staleWhileRevalidate import, so the harness standard has nothing to govern in this context.

pairs.subject: eval-harness
pairs.evidence: src/features/plugins/drive/hooks/__tests__/useDrive.test.ts:189 The Drive suite is deterministic Vitest unit tests over a UI state hook, which belongs to the test-harness subject. It has no non-deterministic model candidate, so there is nothing for trials, judges or aggregation to apply to. A search of src/features/plugins/drive found no judge, rubric, benchmark or pass-rate terms. The 'scenario' hits are ScenarioEmptyState UI states and the one 'verdict' hit is signature verification.

pairs.evidence: src/features/schedules/libs/__tests__/matchPastSlotsToRuns.test.ts:32 The schedules context projects cron fires and matches past slots to executions inside a fixed tolerance window.
